profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at The MathWorks
profile.summary:
Computational Mathematics Specialist with over ten years of experience applying computational methods to the solution of engineering and financial risk management problems. Strong modeling skills in a broad range of areas of application, backed by work experience in the oil, banking and process-engineering industries, and by a solid interdisciplinary academic background. Extensive experience with both prototypes and production software for numerical simulations and optimization.

Goal: To contribute to the solution of challenging quantitative problems by combining modeling insight with effective (whether “best-practice” or novel) computational techniques.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Maintained Aspen Open Solvers (AOS), a library of numerical solvers for simulation and optimization (C++, FORTRAN, C#). Provided technical advice to other teams in the company (linear algebra, integration, optimization, deterministic and Monte-Carlo simulations) and third-level support to customers on issues related to the numerical solvers.
     I expanded the capabilities of AOS with new interfaces and solvers, and participated in four projects of Aspentech’s research initiative.

positions.title: Givens Associate (intern)
positions.description: Prototyped the integration of the “Toolkit for Advanced Optimization” and the “Automatic Differentiation in C” libraries (C++, MPI).

positions.title: Vice-President
positions.description: Provided internal consulting on risk management to different areas within the bank. Designed methodology and implemented prototypes (Monte Carlo simulations, parametric models, etc.) for risk - adjusted pricing and line of credit for derivatives, estimation of probability distribution of losses, diversification, and stress-test analysis for corporate loans portfolio, and risk-adjusted pricing for corporate loans.

positions.title: Quantitative Analyst
positions.description: Developed methodology and implemented a prototype for line of credit estimation, via Monte Carlo simulation, for natural gas customers. Collaborated on the design and implementation of the corporate risk management benchmarking and risk-tracking systems, in conjunction with Banque Paribas consulting staff.
